headline: Get three quotes for a 100/300/50, full tort, $500-deductible policy before your registration deadline.
steps: Request quotes for this exact configuration from at least three sources, including one independent agency.
Ask your lender for its coverage requirements in writing and confirm each quote meets them.
Confirm the full tort election in writing on the policy you choose.
Set up autopay from checking on a date after your biweekly payday.
Move $150 to savings before January 15, because that month dips below your floor.
Keep proof of insurance with you for the registration appointment.
questions_to_ask: Is the quoted premium six-month or annual?
What is the surcharge if I change tort election later?
Is there a student or good-grade discount?
Does this policy satisfy my lender's requirements?

citations.title: Automobile Insurance Guide
citations.excerpt: Pennsylvania law requires all registered vehicles to carry liability coverage of at least 15/30/5 and $5,000 in first-party medical benefits.
